cards.ex: We're planning a hike this weekend, weather permitting.
cards.exUz: Agar ob-havo yaxshi bo'lsa, bu hafta oxiri sayr qilishni rejalashtiryapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Agar ob-havo yaxshi bo'lsa, rejalashtirilgan narsa amalga oshiriladi.

cards.ex: Deforestation is leading to a shrinking habitat for many species.
cards.exUz: O'rmonlarning kesilishi ko'plab turlar uchun yashash muhitining qisqarishiga olib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar yashaydigan maydonning kamayishi, torayishi.

cards.ex: The sheep were grazing on the hillside.
cards.exUz: Qo'ylar tepalik yonbag'rida o'tlab yurishardi.
cards.uzDef: Chorva mollari o't yoki o'simliklarni yemoq.

cards.ex: These animals can no longer survive in the wild.
cards.exUz: Bu hayvonlar endi tabiat qo'ynida omon qololmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uy hayvonlari yoki odamlar g'amxo'rligisiz, tabiatda yashamoq.

cards.ex: A swarm of bees flew into the garden.
cards.exUz: Bir to'da asalarilar bog'ga uchib kirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p sonli hasharotlar yoki boshqa kichik jonzotlar birga harakatlanishi.

cards.ex: Her animal instincts kicked in when she sensed danger.
cards.exUz: Xavfni sezganida uning hayvoniy instinktlari ishga tushdi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar tug'ma xulq-atvorlari, o'z-o'zini himoya qilish qobiliyatlari.

cards.ex: We drove through a lush landscape of rolling hills.
cards.exUz: Biz tepaliklarning serhosil manzarasi bo'ylab mashina haydadik.
cards.uzDef: Yashil o'simliklar bilan qoplangan go'zal va boy hudud.

cards.ex: The oil spill severely damaged the fragile ecosystem.
cards.exUz: Neftning to'kilishi nozik ekotizimga jiddiy zarar yetkazdi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishlarga juda sezgir bo'lgan ekologik tizim.

cards.ex: The horses roam freely across the open fields.
cards.exUz: Otlar ochiq dalalarda erkin kezib yurishadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday cheklovlarsiz, istalgan joyda erkin harakatlanmoq.

cards.ex: This area provides a natural habitat for many birds.
cards.exUz: Bu hudud ko'plab qushlar uchun tabiiy yashash joyini ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar yoki o'simliklar tabiiy ravishda yashaydigan joy.

cards.ex: Hikers should strive to leave no trace on the trails.
cards.exUz: Sayohatchilar yo'laklarda hech qanday iz qoldirmaslikka harakat qilishlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tabiatda bo'lganingizda, unga hech qanday zarar yetkazmaslik.

cards.ex: We organized a scavenger hunt in the woods for the kids.
cards.exUz: Biz bolalar uchun o'rmonda topish o'yinini tashkil qildik.
cards.uzDef: Ro'yxatdagi narsalarni topish uchun o'tkaziladigan o'yin (tabiatda ham bo'lishi mumkin).

cards.ex: The small boat was at the mercy of the storm.
cards.exUz: Kichkina qayiq bo'ronning rahmiga qaram edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir kuchli ta'siri ostida bo'lmoq, himoyasiz.

cards.ex: The rain was a breath of life to the parched land.
cards.exUz: Yomg'ir qurg'oqchil yerlarga hayot nafasini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yangi va jonlantiruvchi, hayotga qaytaruvchi.

cards.ex: The garden went to seed because we didn't tend to it.
cards.exUz: Bog'ga e'tibor bermaganimiz sababli u urug'lab ketdi.
cards.uzDef: O'simlik urug' berish bosqichiga yetmoq, qarimoq (maj.).

cards.ex: We saw a flock of geese flying overhead.
cards.exUz: Biz tepamizdan g'ozlarning to'dasini uchib o'tayotganini ko'rdik.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda uchadigan yoki to'planadigan qushlar guruhi.

cards.ex: A pack of wolves roams the forest.
cards.exUz: O'rmonda bo'rilar uyuri kezib yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Birgalikda ov qiladigan yoki yashaydigan yirtqich hayvonlar guruhi.

cards.ex: Sustainable development is crucial for the planet's future.
cards.exUz: Barqaror rivojlanish sayyoramiz kelajagi uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Kelajak avlodlarga zarar yetkazmasdan, hozirgi ehtiyojlarni qondirish.

cards.ex: The coastline is eroding away due to rising sea levels.
cards.exUz: Dengiz sathining ko'tarilishi sababli qirg'oq chizig'i yemirilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sekin-asta yo'q bo'lib ketmoq, suv yoki shamol ta'sirida.

cards.ex: The rainforest is teeming with life.
cards.exUz: Tropik o'rmon hayotga to'la.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p turli xil hayvonlar va o'simliklar bilan to'lgan joy.

cards.ex: We love to eat our lunch in the open air.
cards.exUz: Biz tushlikni ochiq havoda yeyishni yaxshi ko'ramiz.
cards.uzDef: Binolardan tashqarida, toza havoda bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The old barn was weather-beaten and worn.
cards.exUz: Eski ombor ob-havo ta'sirida eskirgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Ob-havo ta'sirida shikastlangan yoki eskirgan narsa.

cards.ex: He's wild at heart and loves to travel.
cards.exUz: U yovvoyi ruhli va sayohat qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.
cards.uzDef: Erkinlikni va sarguzashtlarni sevadigan odam.

cards.ex: This lake is an important feeding ground for migratory birds.
cards.exUz: Bu ko'l ko'chmanchi qushlar uchun muhim ovqatlanish joyidir.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar muntazam ravishda ovqatlanadigan joy.

cards.ex: We vacationed in a beautiful chain of islands.
cards.exUz: Biz orollarning go'zal zanjirida ta'til o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Bir qatorda joylashgan orollar guruhi.

cards.ex: We want to preserve this area as nature intended.
cards.exUz: Biz bu hududni tabiat xohlaganidek saqlab qolmoqchimiz.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar tomonidan o'zgartirilmagan yoki buzilmagan holatda.

cards.ex: The new discovery offered a ray of hope for the endangered species.
cards.exUz: Yangi kashfiyot yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan turlar uchun umid nurini berdi.
cards.uzDef: Umidning ozgina bo'lsada mavjudligi, imkoniyat.

cards.ex: Small animals often fall prey to larger predators.
cards.exUz: Kichik hayvonlar ko'pincha yirik yirtqichlarning o'ljasiga aylanadi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning qurboni bo'lish, xavf ostida qolish.

cards.ex: The wetlands are an important breeding ground for many birds.
cards.exUz: Botqoqliklar ko'plab qushlar uchun muhim ko'payish joyidir.
cards.uzDef: Hayvonlar ko'payadigan joy, nasl qoldiradigan hudud.

cards.ex: We need to live in harmony with nature.
cards.exUz: Biz tabiat bilan uyg'unlikda yashashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bilan kelishgan holda, birgalikda yaxshi yashash.
